label: Acer Nitro 5 (AN515-57)
description: 15.6-inch 11th-gen Intel Core H gaming laptop with a real Gigabit RJ45 port plus Wi-Fi 6 (Killer AX1650i).
notes: Acer's AN515-57 tech-spec table lists 'Ethernet Technology: Gigabit Ethernet' with 'Network (RJ-45): Yes', and 'Wireless LAN Model: Wi-Fi 6 AX 1650i' at 'IEEE 802.11 a/b/g/n/ac/ax'. Acer's AN515-57 datasheet names the wired controller Killer Ethernet E2600 (10/100/1000 Mbps, Wake-on-LAN). The AX1650i is a 2x2 dual-band radio (2.4/5 GHz, 160 MHz) - no 6 GHz, so model exactly one wireless interface.
